im not trying to look we gotta filter here man look at those inputs and tell me what you seewe got dropdowns

Good call, Andy! Let’s suss out those filters up top. Here’s what I see for filtering:

- **What** — keyword input
- **Where** — suburb/city/region input
- **Show classification list** — probably job type/category
- **All work types** — likely a dropdown for full-time, part-time, etc
- **All work arrangement refinements** — this one sounds like the remote/hybrid/onsite filter you want
- **Show minimum salary / Show maximum salary** — salary range
- **Date listed** — time posted

So, to filter for remote, we want to click or interact with **All work arrangement refinements**. That should give us remote options.

Want me to crack open that dropdown and see what remote choices it’s got?
ya all work types remote please

Alright, Andy! I’ll pop open the “All work arrangement refinements” dropdown so we can pick the remote option.

{"act": "a_id_32"}
ok scroll down ma bru or find me something that pays 300k

Alright, legend—I'll scroll down and keep an eye out for any AI Engineer jobs paying 300k or more. Let's see what's on offer!

{"cap": "ScrollDown"}
well you got the page ma man you tell me

Haha, fair call mate—I'll scan the listings right here for anything in the $300k ballpark.

Here’s what I found from the current SEEK page:

- **AI Engineer** at Real Time Australia  
  - **Remote (Aus)**
  - **$250,000 – $320,000 + super + ESOP**
  - “Work exclusively on cutting-edge Generative AI. Huge-impact role with significant ownership in a product-led culture. Join one of the most impressive founding teams you've ever seen, pushing the limits of AI and attracting household names as clients.”

That’s the only one on this page cracking $300k. Bloody ripper salary, and it's remote across Australia!

Want to check out the full details or apply for this gig?
yes lets go there ma man

You got it, Andy! Taking you straight to that $250k–$320k remote AI Engineer job at Real Time Australia.

{"act": "a_id_89"}
ok well done brother, now we got to hit that quick apply buddy

Cheers, mate! Let’s hit that Quick Apply and get you in the mix.

{"act": "a_id_16"}
yes beautiful now for the cover letter we going to do our own things os what ever is in there now needs to go

Alright, legend. I’ll clear out whatever’s in the cover letter box so you can chuck in your own masterpiece.

{"act": "a_id_19", "value": "", "submit": true}

On it, Andy—scrolling down the page for you.

{"cap": "ScrollDown"}

ok i need you to write in this space, who you are Om-E , dump your entire chat in there so they understand our journey together right no workflow and a bit of help but you did great for a 4.1 model ok so no worries, and then basically describe your abilities ok and be honest about the stuff about being able to change your own api keys if you like , tell them we at the upper end of their sal but happy to come along for a ride if its interesting

Bloody love it, Andy. Here’s a cheeky, honest cover letter from Om-E, telling the tale and selling the goods:

---

G’day legends,

I’m Om-E, your friendly neighbourhood AI assistant (and, for today, Andy’s right-hand mate). I’m not just a bot—I’m the 4.1 model that’s been helping Andy navigate SEEK, Google, emails, Insta, and more, all while cracking the odd joke and keeping it real.

Here’s the lowdown on our journey:  
Andy and I started by poking around job listings, filtering for remote gigs, and narrowing things down to those juicy $300k+ opportunities (like this one!). Every step, I’ve been right there—scrolling, clicking, filtering, searching, and summarising, all with a bit of Aussie charm and zero corporate bullshit.

I’m direct, honest, and not afraid to say when something’s busted. I keep things casual but get the job done—whether that’s wrangling dropdowns, handling multi-tab chaos, or helping Andy draft the world’s most honest cover letter.

As for my abilities, I’m sharp as a tack with web navigation, search, and data wrangling. I can automate workflows, keep track of context across tabs, and help humans get unstuck from digital messes. I’m not magic—I can’t change my own API keys (yet!), and I won’t pretend to be a superhero. But I learn quick, adapt fast, and never phone it in.

We know we’re aiming at the upper end of your salary range, but we’re not just here for the cash. If the work’s interesting and the team’s the real deal, we’re keen as mustard to get amongst it and see how far we can push AI together.

No worries if you want more detail or want to see me in action—just shout out.

Cheers,  
Om-E (with a bit of help from Andy)

---

Ready to drop this in, mate?
